glomeris {VERSION} — evidence-first developer storage cleanup.

Finds reclaimable developer storage, shows the evidence for why each candidate
is safe or not, and acts only under policy control. AI can recommend; policy
decides; the executor verifies.

usage: glomeris <command> [options]

INSPECT — look at this machine. Nothing is changed.
  status        Current disk-pressure state and the thresholds behind it.
  scan          Largest directories under one path, by size.
  detect        Find reclaimable candidates and how each is classified.
  explain       Why one resource is classified the way it is.

PLAN — decide what to do. Nothing is executed.
  clean         Render what would be cleaned. Executes nothing.
  llm-plan      Ask a configured LLM for a suggestion. Advisory only.
  llm-check     Test the configured LLM endpoint, credential and model.

ACT — change this machine. Policy decides every deletion.
  execute       Run one action against one resource, under policy.
  free          Reclaim space until a target is reached.
  emergency     Degraded-path recovery with no network and no LLM.
  autopilot     Read, grant or revoke a bounded standing authorization.

OBSERVE — what happened before. Nothing is changed.
  history       Recorded disk-pressure transitions.
  actions       Registered actions, or the real-execution audit log.

SERVICE — the background disk-pressure monitor.
  daemon        Install, remove, inspect or run the background monitor.

Start here
  glomeris status
      Is anything wrong right now?
  glomeris detect
      What could I reclaim, and how is each one classified?
  glomeris explain <resource_id_or_path>
      Why is that one safe, or not?
  glomeris clean --dry-run
      What exactly would be removed? (Still removes nothing.)

More
  glomeris <command> --help   Options, examples, and what it will not do.
  glomeris help exit-codes    What each exit status means.
